---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: car-secret
type: Opaque
data:
  secretData: YWRtaW4K 
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: my-tls-secret
type: kubernetes.io/tls
data:
  tls.crt: 
  tls.key: 
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: car-project
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: car-project
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: car-project
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: car-project
          image: venkatmaddala/car-purchasing-based-on-customers-reviews:latest
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          env:
          - name: SECRET_KEY
            valueFrom:
              secretKeyRef:
                name: car-secret
                key: secretData

          - name: SSL_CERT_DATA
            valueFrom:
              secretKeyRef:
                name: 
                key: tls.crt        

          - name: SSL_KEY_DATA
            valueFrom:
              secretKeyRef:
                name: my-tls-secret 
                key: tls.key

          # Using an inline shell script to patch settings.py right before running the entrypoint
          command: ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
          args:
            - |
              # Write the SSL credentials from environment variables to files
              echo "$SSL_CERT_DATA" > /tmp/tls.crt
              echo "$SSL_KEY_DATA" > /tmp/tls.key

              # Locate and configure Django settings
              SETTINGS_FILE=$(find . -name "settings.py" | head -n 1)
              
              if [ -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
                cat << 'EOF' >> "$SETTINGS_FILE"

              # --- Kubernetes Ingress/HTTPS Configurations ---
              SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = False
              SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = True
              CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = True
              SECURE_PROXY_SSL_HEADER = ('HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO', 'https')
              EOF
              fi

              # Find the WSGI module dynamically
              WSGI_PATH=$(find . -name "wsgi.py" | head -n 1)
              MODULE_NAME=$(echo "$WSGI_PATH" | sed 's|./||; s|/wsgi.py||; s|/|.|g')

              # Run Gunicorn termination natively on HTTP port 8000
              # Nginx Ingress will handle the HTTPS decryption layer
              exec gunicorn ${MODULE_NAME}.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:8000
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: car-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: car-project
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 8000
  type: ClusterIP
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: car-ingress
  annotations:
    kubernetes.io/ingress.class: "nginx"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "600"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "600"
spec:
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - yourdomain.com
    secretName: my-tls-secret
  rules:
  - host: yourdomain.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: car-service
            port:
              number: 80
